hero.lede: I'm Naod, a full-stack developer in Addis Ababa. For 5+ years I've built SaaS products, e-commerce platforms and APIs for 17+ clients — the interface people use and the systems underneath it.

about.statement: I started on the frontend, and it still shapes how I build everything underneath.
bio: For years my work was interfaces: turning Figma and Adobe XD designs into responsive, production-ready screens, and getting the small details of layout and interaction right.

That work kept leading me further down the stack. A slow screen is often a slow query; an awkward form is often an awkward API. So I moved into backend engineering — PHP, Laravel, MySQL and REST APIs — and now build products end to end.

Starting from the interface changes how I build the rest. I design APIs around the screens that consume them, shape database queries around what a page actually needs, and treat performance as part of the user experience rather than a separate task.

impact.intro: The work I'm most often brought in for sits where the interface meets the database: pages that feel slow because of what happens behind them.
